title: yb2460/harness-anything
claim: yb2460/harness-anything — Harness Anything - AI agent control hub: WPS, MS Office, Zotero, Photoshop, 47 CLI commands, 27 academic skills, SVG-to-
why_good: A control hub that lets agents drive desktop apps (Office, Zotero, Photoshop) plus dozens of CLIs — the 'hands' layer for real desktop automation.
value: Seat/usage pricing to knowledge workers and teams automating cross-app workflows; the wedge is breadth of reliable app control.
risk: Huge surface to keep working as apps change; computer-use from the labs and OS makers competes directly.
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product concept for a unified AI tool management interface that can be monetized.
